Events & Matches

 
CSV import supports a simple schedule format: event,match_number,table,run_type,team1,team2,start_time. Review imported rows before relying on them at an event.

 
Announcer Excel Upload (.xlsx)
Upload one Excel workbook with match and team information. Works offline in modern browsers. Review the preview before saving to this browser. Existing events and teams are preserved unless matching entries are updated.

 

 

 
Accepts the original Colorado FLL schedule workbook directly (Team Info + emcee(am) + emcee(pm)), or a simple Excel template with match_number, team1, team2. Both morning practice and afternoon official matches are imported as separate events. Works offline.
